info.title: Gnovium Knowledge OS API
info.description:
Gnovium API is a local-first Knowledge Operating System API for building applications where knowledge behaves like a living system rather than a collection of disconnected documents.

This API supports:
- Block-based content management with rich text editing
- Structured relational knowledge modeling with typed entities and properties
- Interactive knowledge graph with traversal, pathfinding, and queries
- Git-inspired versioning with branches, snapshots, and visual diffs
- AI-powered semantic search and natural language question answering
- Workspace governance with health scoring and duplicate detection
- Cross-device synchronization with conflict resolution
- File management with presigned URL uploads (cloud mode)

Deployment modes:
- **Local Mode** (default): SQLite storage, offline-first, local AI via Inference Runtime
- **Cloud Mode**: PostgreSQL, S3 storage, managed infrastructure

get.description: Public liveness endpoint for load balancers, uptime checks, and deployment smoke tests. Requires no authentication.

post.description: Cloud-only. Creates a user account. Passwords must be at least 8 characters and are stored as bcrypt hashes. Returns JWT access and refresh tokens.
Cloud-only. Authenticates with email and password, creates a server-side session, and returns JWT access and refresh tokens.
Cloud-only. Uses a valid refresh token to issue a new access token. Send the refresh token in the Authorization header. Only a new access_token is returned — the existing refresh token is reused.

get.description: Cloud-only. Checks whether an email address is already registered. Public endpoint, no auth required.

post.description: Cloud-only. Authenticates using a Google OAuth credential token. Returns the same token envelope as login.
Cloud-only. Revokes the current refresh-token session so it cannot be used again.

get.description: Cloud-only. Returns the authenticated user's profile including email, name, avatar, and timestamps.

patch.description: Cloud-only. Partially updates the authenticated user's profile. Only send the fields you want to change.

get.description: Returns workspaces owned by or accessible to the current user.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

post.description: Creates a workspace and associates it with the authenticated user as the owner.

get.description: Retrieves a single workspace by ID.

patch.description: Partially updates workspace name, description, or settings. Setting description to null clears it. Settings replaces the entire dict — omitted keys are lost, set a key to null to clear it.

delete.description: Deletes a workspace permanently. All associated entities, blocks, relations, tags, files, comments, and notifications are deleted.

get.description: Returns a curated snapshot of workspace health and activity — entity count, block count, relation count, recent changes, and member stats.
Returns entities, optionally filtered by workspace and entity type.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

post.description: Creates a page, record, or graph node inside a workspace. The entity_type_id determines what properties the entity supports.

get.description: Retrieves one entity by ID including its properties and metadata.

patch.description: Partially updates title, icon, cover image, archive flag, or flexible properties. Omitted fields remain unchanged.

delete.description: Deletes an entity permanently. Cascades to all blocks, property values, relations, tags, file links, comments, and notifications. Use POST /entities/<id>/restore to undo the deletion.

post.description: Marks an entity as archived without deleting it. Archived entities are hidden from default views but can be searched and restored.
Restores a deleted entity back to active status.
Creates a deep copy of an entity including all its blocks and properties. The copy is titled "Original Copy" by default.

get.description: Returns direct child entities of a parent entity. Children inherit the parent's workspace context.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

post.description: Creates a new entity as a child of the specified parent. Inherits the parent workspace. Ideal for hierarchical knowledge structures.

get.description: Cloud-only. Returns version history for an entity. Each entry represents a point-in-time snapshot of the entity's state. Cloud-only — returns 404 in local mode.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

get.description: Returns entity type definitions for a workspace. Each type defines a reusable schema for entities.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

post.description: Defines a reusable type for entities in a workspace. Custom types enable structured knowledge modeling.

get.description: Returns property definitions for a workspace or entity type. Properties define the schema for entity metadata.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

post.description: Adds a reusable typed property to a workspace or entity type. Supported types: text, number, select, multi_select, date, boolean, url.

get.description: Returns all tags for a workspace.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

post.description: Creates a new tag with an optional color. Tags are lightweight labels that can be applied to entities.

get.description: Retrieves a single tag by ID.

patch.description: Partially updates a tag's name or color.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a tag. Entity-tag associations are also removed.

post.description: Applies a tag to an entity. Both the tag and entity must exist in the same workspace.

delete.description: Removes a tag from an entity. The tag itself is not deleted.

get.description: Returns blocks for an entity. If no entity_id is specified, returns all blocks across the user's accessible workspaces.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

post.description: Creates a block inside an entity. If position is omitted, the block is appended after existing siblings. Block types: text, heading_1-3, bulleted_list, numbered_list, to_do, code, quote, callout, image, divider, table.

get.description: Retrieves a single block by ID.

patch.description: Partially updates a block's type, position, parent, or content. Only send the fields that changed.

post.description: Moves a block to a new parent and/or position. Fractional positions allow insertion between siblings without re-indexing.
Batch-updates block positions for an entity in a single call. Provide an ordered array of block IDs with new positions.

get.description: Shorthand for listing all blocks belonging to a specific entity.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

get.description: Returns graph relations for a workspace.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

post.description: Creates a typed edge between two entities. Relation types are free-form strings: references, depends_on, part_of, related_to, implements, extends, or custom.

get.description: Retrieves a single relation by ID.

delete.description: Deletes a relation permanently. The entities remain unaffected.

get.description: Returns all relations where the specified entity is the source — the "what I link to" view.
Returns all relations where the specified entity is the target — the "who links to me" view.
Returns all neighboring entities and their relation types around a given node. Used by the graph renderer to build localized views.
Finds the shortest path between two entities in the relation graph using BFS.
Lists all comments, optionally filtered by entity or parent comment (for threaded replies).

parameters.name: parent_comment_id
parameters.description: List replies for this parent comment.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

post.description: Creates a comment on an entity, block, or as a reply to another comment. At least one of entity_id or block_id must be provided.

get.description: Retrieves a single comment by ID.

patch.description: Updates comment text. The content field is required in the update body.

delete.description: Deletes a comment permanently. Threaded replies are preserved.

get.description: Returns version-control branches for a workspace.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

post.description: Creates a branch for workspace experimentation or review workflows. Branches are Git-inspired — safe spaces to make changes without affecting the main knowledge base.

get.description: Retrieves a single branch by ID.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a branch and its associated changesets and snapshots.

post.description: Merges the specified branch into a target branch. Creates a merge changeset capturing the diff.
Merges any two branches by specifying both source and target branch IDs explicitly.

get.description: Cloud-only. Returns changesets for a branch. Each changeset represents a group of changes with a message.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

post.description: Cloud-only. Creates a changeset, optionally attached to a snapshot. Changesets track what changed and why.

get.description: Cloud-only. Returns named snapshots for a branch. Snapshots are point-in-time markers of workspace state.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

post.description: Cloud-only. Creates a named snapshot marker for a branch. Snapshots capture the full workspace state at a point in time.
Cloud-only. Captures the current entity state into an entity version record. Optionally attach to a changeset.

get.description: Cloud-only. Returns version history for an entity. Each version is a point-in-time snapshot that can be compared or restored.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

get.description: Cloud-only. Returns version history for a specific block within an entity.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

get.description: Cloud-only. Returns a field-level diff between two entity versions. Shows what changed between left (older) and right (newer).

post.description: Cloud-only. Applies a saved entity version snapshot back onto the live entity. Creates a new version entry for audit trail.
Cloud-only. Returns a structured diff between two snapshots or branches. Shows added, removed, and modified blocks with their content changes. Ideal for building visual diff viewers.

get.description: Searches entities and blocks by keyword, PostgreSQL full text, hybrid, or semantic mode. Hybrid mode combines keyword matching with embedding similarity for the best results.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Search mode: keyword, full_text, hybrid (default), or semantic.

post.description: Submits a natural language question about your workspace. The API retrieves relevant context via semantic search, assembles it as context, and asks the configured Inference Runtime (local GPU-native or cloud) to answer based on your knowledge. Returns both the answer and source documents.

get.description: Returns file metadata records filtered by workspace or uploader.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

post.description: Creates a metadata record for an already-uploaded object. Storage provider is set automatically based on the current mode (local disk in local mode, S3 in cloud mode).
Uploads a file using multipart/form-data. In local mode, the file is saved to the local filesystem. In cloud mode, it is uploaded to S3.

get.description: Retrieves a single file metadata record by ID.

delete.description: Deletes a file permanently. The underlying file bytes are removed from disk.

get.description: Streams file content directly. In local mode, serves from the local filesystem. In cloud mode, redirects to the S3 public URL.

post.description: Finds all file records with zero entity links and deletes them permanently (database record + disk bytes). Omitting workspace_id cleans up orphans across all workspaces.
Cloud-only. Returns an S3 presigned upload URL for direct browser-to-S3 uploads. Only available in cloud mode. Returns 404 in local mode.
Associates an uploaded file with an entity and optionally a specific block within that entity.

get.description: Returns the latest stored graph snapshot for a workspace. Create one first with POST /graph/materialize.

post.description: Builds and stores a fresh graph snapshot from current entities and relations. Call this after significant changes before querying the graph.
Returns filtered nodes and edges for a workspace. Supports filtering by relation type and entity type. Ideal for rendering a subset of the knowledge graph.
BFS traversal starting from a center node up to a configurable depth. Returns all reachable nodes and edges. Depth is capped at 5 to prevent runaway queries.
Finds the shortest BFS path between two entities. Returns ordered node IDs, traversed edges, and distance. Returns distance: -1 with empty path if no connection exists.

get.description: Cloud-only. Returns sync operations for a workspace. Set pending=true to return unsynced operations only.

parameters.name: pending
parameters.description: When true, only pending (unsynced) operations are returned.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

post.description: Cloud-only. Ingests a client operation for cross-device synchronization. Used by the offline sync engine to queue changes made on other devices.

get.description: Cloud-only. Retrieves a single sync operation by ID.

post.description: Cloud-only. Marks a sync operation as applied. Used to confirm that an operation has been processed by the server.

get.description: Returns recent activity log records for a workspace. Each entry shows who did what, when, and on which entity.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

get.description: Returns the latest workspace health report including health score, duplicate count, orphan count, and stale entity count. Does not recalculate — use POST /governance/health-score for fresh data.
Returns entities with identical (case-insensitive) titles within a workspace.
Returns entities with zero relations — no incoming or outgoing connections. These entities are isolated from the knowledge graph.
Returns entities not updated in 90+ days. Use this to identify knowledge that needs refreshing.

post.description: Forces a fresh health score calculation. Score ranges from 0–100 based on duplicate (×5), orphan (×2), and stale penalties.

get.description: Returns notifications filtered by workspace and/or user.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

post.description: Creates a notification for a user. Notification types: mention, comment, update, invite, system.
Marks a single notification as read.

get.description: Cloud-only. Returns background job records for a workspace.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

post.description: Cloud-only. Creates a background job record with an arbitrary payload. Jobs track async operations like graph materialization or embedding refresh.
Cloud-only. Transitions a job from queued to the running state.
Cloud-only. Transitions a job to completed and stores its result payload.

get.description: Returns a curated snapshot of workspace activity and health — entity count, block count, relation count, comments, members, archived items, and recently updated entities. Ideal for building workspace home screens.

post.description: Exports all workspace data as a portable JSON bundle. Includes entities, blocks, relations, tags, branches, versions, and file metadata. Works across local and cloud modes.
Same as export but writes the JSON to instance/backups/ on the server instead of returning it inline. Useful for automated local backups or pre-migration snapshots.

Imports workspace data from a JSON bundle. Creates entities, blocks, relations, tags, and more from the provided data. Note: the files field in the import body is informational only and is not imported.

BearerAuth.description: JWT access token obtained via OAuth2 or direct login. Format: Bearer <token>

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key for server-to-server authentication. Generate from workspace settings.

scopes.workspace:write: Create, update, and delete workspace content
scopes.workspace:admin: Manage workspace settings, members, and billing
scopes.offline_access: Receive refresh tokens for long-lived access
